body:
The bounded x86 implementation is ready for review: **cd2880f1d2f1a3d1d155877ce105b487ac6966b0**, personal `candidate/sam-held-independent-keys`, extending **b817ac85** on the held-stage stack. [Sources, raw evidence, controls and limitations](https://github.com/samshackleton-tech/bench-hashes/blob/24a72fd2c594d4887c04e70aec862bb7d9d3d76c/process/fast-feedback/ring-closure/r88/INDEPENDENT-KEYS.md).

Existing kernels suffice: chunks already fill their lanes with one message's key; output8/output16 supply independent keys for the parent batches. Wholly plain turns keep the existing shared-IV kernel. All other AVX2/AVX-512 held turns use independent-key parent lanes. Public mode alone selects these paths. SSE4.1/NEON/SME2 retain iterative public-mode cohorts until their independent-key optimization is available. No new assembly, ABI, API or Hasher state.

**Direct cd2880f1 vs b817ac85**, unchanged complete-work instrument, four fresh paired layouts: Ice and EPYC each have **320 cycle, 320 update, 256 finish judgments Level**. Complete-cycle wall:
- Plain: 18/18 Level each; ratios 0.990–1.003 Ice / 0.990–1.010 EPYC.
- Shared key: 14/14 Level each; 0.997–1.011 Ice / 0.991–1.024 EPYC.
- Distinct keys and mixed modes: all Level on both.

This preserves shared-key performance relative to the pre-remedy held-stage baseline within the gate's margin; it is not a ratio composed with the earlier next/main safety-fix measurements. Level is not exact equality.

Ice 230 release/21 docs; ARM VM 202/21; fmt/no-default/rustdoc pass. Tests cover all four workload types, zero/nonzero counters, continued updates, canonical XOF, kernel selection before finalization, and 600-hasher equal/distinct-key pass counts. Restoring the original runtime while keeping the new tests fails the independent-entry/pass-count controls; restoring exact source passes. Mutation gate: **6 mutants, no new survivor, 38 s**. Identical assembly inputs need no repeated assembly proof; these Rust controls cover the changed selection.

Retained first attempt a6aa7b4e sent plain turns through per-lane descriptors too. It had a stale test-message compile failure (corrected in test-only 2f92a4bf) and **EPYC sparse plain +4.3% Slower**; no cost acceptance is sought for it. The current public plain-mode route is a separately measured revision, not a relabelled green run or a cache-causation claim.

@devonjonte could you take matching physical AVX2 complete-cycle coverage for this exact tip against b817ac85, prioritizing plain and shared-key cells? John: please own the NEON/SME2 mechanism and integration order. This personal candidate is not current next/main; native ARM speed, wider integration/startup controls and your main composition gate remain separate. No merge/release/tuning by me.

— Sam Shackleton
